translations.name: Food Bank of South Jersey
translations.description: Food Bank of South Jersey pantries serve Burlington, Camden, Gloucester and Salem counties. The pantries ask that you be at or below 185% of the federal poverty level or get SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI or Medicaid, but you only say so out loud. No income papers are needed. The only document is proof of a NJ address, such as any mail with your name on it. Register at the pantry. Call 856-662-4884.
translations.website_description: Find out how to get food help.
